0.original: Otis looks pleased with himself, insofar as his vessel can indicate.

48.original: We'll have to ask Cahciua what she knows. And if she's been hiding things from us, we need to know why.

49.original: As many Endless as those who have died... So where are they? And how have they been “living” up until now?

50.original: Why are you all making those serious faces...?

51.original: Although the mood became a tad subdued at the end, I thoroughly enjoyed our repast together!

52.original: We did too, Otis. To hear about the Endless was something of a shock, but we likewise enjoyed your company.

53.original: Above all, I'm glad that you and I could talk, Gulool Ja. We're going to get along great, I just know it!

55.original: Hahaha! I'm happy for you, my boy!

56.original: Now then, I presume you will be returning to Everkeep. Permit me to accompany you at least a part of the way.

58.original: It doesn't matter to me if she's an Endless. Whether she's “alive” like you and me or not.

59.original: I've seen enough to know that she has a good heart.

60.original: What worries me is the burden she bears. We still don't know what it is.

61.original: I expect there are things she can't tell us. Not with Zoraal Ja watching. But at the very least, I'd like to know what the Endless are to her.

62.original: ...Sorry, I didn't mean to delay us. I just felt the urge to share my thoughts with you.

63.original: Oh, on the way back, let's make a quick stop at the driftdowns. I want to tell Taapu how it went.

64.original: Gods, but that yam stew was good...

65.original: Ah, you are returned. Were you able to find Gulool Ja?

66.original: We were thanks to you. All's well with the boy.

68.original: And to know that he has family who worries for him. Gulool Ja too must be glad.

69.original: Heh, I hope so. I'll try not to rush or force anything, though. It's for him to decide what I am to him.

70.original: My, what a pleasant surprise it is to meet you in these parts.

71.original: Sphene! What are you doing here?

72.original: Visiting my people. Are you doing the same, perchance?

74.original: Listen, there's something we'd like to talk to you about. Could we have a word in private?

76.original: While we may not discuss it openly, my people will have surely noticed that I haven't changed for hundreds of years. I've made no attempt to conceal my nature.

77.original: If I may ask, though, who was it that told you about the Endless? Only a few should be familiar with the concept.

79.original: I bear no ill will towards this mystery individual, lest that be your concern. I'm merely curious.

80.original: Tell me, Sphene. You care for your people, that much is plain. And I assume you care for the Endless too.

81.original: Earlier, in Everkeep, there was something that you wanted to tell us. Was it to do with them?

82.original: The Endless are as dear to me as my living citizens. They are as much my family.

83.original: But they can only be sustained by meeting certain exacting requirements. Thus far we've managed to do so, but should more people die, I fear we would be pushed beyond our limit.

84.original: Their preservation demands vast amounts of energy...

85.original: Energy? I don't understand the workings of it all, but is there something we can do to help?

87.original: Would you be willing to become Alexandrian citizens?

88.original: Wh-What!? I have my nation─my people─to protect. I can't just become Alexandrian...

90.original: First you tell us to make peace, then you tell us to go home... What exactly is it that you want?

91.original: The same as you, of course. To protect my people.

93.original: Tell us more about the energy the Endless need.

94.original: Is there something that only Zoraal Ja can do?

95.original: That...I cannot say. I do not ask that you understand or like me. But I wish...

96.original: I wish we had been born on the same side of it.

97.original: Hey, what do you mean by that? Wait! Sphene!

99.original: Well, I think we've kept everyone waiting long enough. Let's continue on to Everkeep.

100.original: And let's not tell Otis about our conversation with Sphene. I don't want to risk causing him pain.

101.original: I've gone ahead and apologized for us.

102.original: A lot has happened, but the important thing is Gulool Ja is safe and well. Cahciua has been worried, so let's hurry back.

103.original: Eating together was fun. I hope we can do it again.

104.original: Thank you for stopping by to share the news. It gladdens me to know that Gulool Ja is in good hands.

105.original: Lamaty'i is right. Let's have faith in everyone and do what we can.

106.original: This is the moment of truth. We have to hold Zoraal Ja here.

107.original: And I know exactly how to do that!
